title: Find the names and artists of all mythic rare cards that are legal in the C
question: Find the names and artists of all mythic rare cards that are legal in the Commander format, have unknown power (either NULL or '*'), and feature the 'boros' watermark. Additionally, include the set name each card belongs to, but only for sets released after January 1, 2015.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049", T1."XCL_002", T2."XCL_110"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'mythic'
  AND T3."XCL_084" = 'commander'
  AND T3."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND T1."XCL_074" = 'boros'
  AND T2."XCL_112" > '2015-01-01'
